description: Defines warning reporting categories classes for various timeout and resource warning scenarios in the Thunder namespace, including serialization, string conversion, and default bounds.

classes.name: TooLongWaitingForLock
classes.description: Represents a warning category for long wait times to acquire a lock.

classes.name: SinkStillHasReference
classes.description: Represents a warning when a sink still holds a reference during destruction.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeRPC
classes.description: Represents a warning for RPC calls that take too long.

classes.name: JobTooLongToFinish
classes.description: Represents a warning for jobs that take too long to complete.

classes.name: JobTooLongWaitingInQueue
classes.description: Represents a warning for jobs waiting too long in queue.

classes.name: TooLongDecrypt
classes.description: Represents a warning for decryption calls that take too long.

classes.name: JobActiveForTooLong
classes.description: Represents a warning for jobs active for too long, indicating potential deadlocks.

classes.name: SocketOperationTooLong
classes.description: Represents a warning for socket operations that exceed expected duration.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes class data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes class data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts warning data into a human-readable string.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes and sets internal IDs for RPC warning.
